articles.title: BitGo to buy NYDIG trading arm for $42.5M in cash and stock plus $15M earnout
articles.snippet: The deal to buy NYDIG IF Holdings comprises $7 million in cash and around $35.5 million in stock, as well as the $15 earnout.

articles.title: An XRP treasury company backed by Ripple is a shareholder vote away from Nasdaq
articles.snippet: The SEC cleared the paperwork for Evernorth's merger with a shell company, setting up a Sept. 30 vote and a listing under the ticker XRPN.

articles.title: Bullish provides USD.AI $100M stablecoin facility for GPU-backed lending
articles.snippet: The institutional crypto exchange is providing $100 million in stablecoin liquidity to support loans backed by AI computing infrastructure.

articles.title: BitGo buys NYDIG trading arm to deepen institutional crypto push
articles.snippet: BitGo completed its acquisition of NYDIG’s institutional trading business, adding about 30 employees and expanding its derivatives and financing capabilities.

articles.title: Abu Dhabi royal backs 49% stake in Trump-linked crypto bank venture: WSJ
articles.snippet: Sheikh Tahnoon’s group reportedly backs a 49% stake in the holding company behind World Liberty’s conditionally approved US trust bank.
